## PHASE 1 — QUERY MATRIX
Deterministic. No LLM needed here.
Edit the services/cities arrays in the Code node.
services x cities = one Serper call each.

## PHASE 2 — HARVEST
Serper Places = Google Maps.
Qualify on rating, review count, website.
Upsert to Airtable on place_id (dedupe).

## PHASE 3 — ENRICH + DRAFT + SEND
Scrape site, find email, one Claude call for
subject + opener, assemble from fixed template,
send, log, wait, repeat.
